response.sql:
WITH status_counts AS (
  SELECT
    powerstatus,
    COUNT(*) AS telescope_count,
    COUNT(*) * 1.0 / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS share
  FROM telescopes
  GROUP BY powerstatus
), above_average AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM status_counts
  WHERE share > AVG(share) OVER ()
)
SELECT
  SUM(telescope_count) AS telescope_count,
  AVG(share) AS average_share,
  AVG(share - (SELECT AVG(share) FROM status_counts)) AS average_amount_above_average
FROM above_average;

assumptions.assumption: “Average share across statuses” means the unweighted arithmetic mean of the shares for each distinct powerstatus group, including NULL as a group.
